Subject: Capacity guardrails — quick architecture deep-dive?

Hi Jamie —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Per our conversation you wanted a technical deep-dive with your infra team to walk through dedicated GPU capacity guardrails (pool sizing, autoscaling knobs, and isolation patterns for multi-tenant workloads).

I proposed a 60–75 minute session to cover:
- target workload profiles and peak v. steady state sizing
- autoscaling policies (scale-step, cooldowns, burst lanes)
- isolation options (logical pools, node-level affinity, tenant fencing)
- fallbacks and graceful degradation (model variants + regional routing)
- Q&A + action items (POC next steps)

Available slots (PT): Tue 2027-07-27 10:00–11:15, Wed 2027-07-28 13:00–14:15, Thu 2027-07-29 09:00–10:15. I attached a short deck with the proposed agenda and a calendar .ics with the slots.

If you prefer, we can keep it to 45 minutes and focus on pool sizing + autoscale. Who from FinWave would you like on the invite (SRE, procurement, security)?

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
